name: "The Warming Hearth-Fire"
description: The Kresnik's Torch prototype, technology from a certain era now refitted as a stove of higher combustion efficiency and greater output.\nIn truth, for the freezing villagers, this prototype — with all its vast connections — is nothing more than a stove that can shed light and heat.\nAnd for the "hunter" who discovered it... Having already secured the "prey," when facing unknown situations to come, knowing when to turn back is the optimal choice.
